top_choice_rationale: Magic-wavelength optical lattice clocks are a mature, independently reproduced fundamental advance in atomic control: they suppress trapping shifts while enabling long interrogation of narrow transitions. Katori and Ye provide the most compact and coherent attribution for the core concept and decisive development.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile. My long-standing work and collaborations in atomic and attosecond physics do not indicate a connection to either proposed laureate.
